title: Runtime Box recipe
description: The declarative input to a build: an identity, a target, a pinned dependency environment, the assets to fetch, and the self-test the result must pass. A recipe is checked into the consumer's repository next to its lock file; everything a build produces is derived from it.

recipeId.description: Must equal the name of the directory holding this file, so a recipe cannot quietly claim an identity other than the one being built.

version.description: Version of the box this recipe produces, as it will appear in the release manifest.

sourceRevision.description: Upstream revision of the packaged source, recorded verbatim into provenance.

pixiVersion.description: Pins the pixi release used to solve and install a conda-forge environment from the committed pixi.lock. Present on the pixi substrate.

uvVersion.description: Pins the uv release used with a hash-pinned requirements.lock and a standalone Python. Present on the legacy substrate.

requirementsInput.description: uv substrate only: the human-edited dependency list the lock is compiled from.

requirementsLock.description: uv substrate only: the hash-pinned lock file, resolved for this exact target.

torchBackend.description: uv substrate only: the PyTorch wheel backend, which must agree with the target accelerator so a CPU box can never ship CUDA wheels or the reverse.

dependencyLicenseAudit.description: Path to the reviewed licence inventory for the installed Python distributions, bound to this exact lock. The build fails if the installed set no longer matches what was reviewed.

condaDependencyLicenseAudit.description: Path to the reviewed licence inventory derived from pixi.lock, which carries an SPDX licence per package.

pythonEntryPoint.description: Interpreter path relative to the box root. Must match the target adapter's layout.

assetBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the mirror the built archive and its objects are published under.

assets.description: Files fetched during the build. Every entry is size- and hash-checked before use, so a moved or replaced upstream file fails the build instead of silently changing the box. May be empty.

assetArchives.description: Downloaded archives to expand into the payload. Extraction preserves files already present in the destination and refuses to overwrite them.

localFiles.description: Files copied from the consumer's own repository into the payload, each verified against a declared hash so a licence notice or runtime shim cannot drift from what was reviewed.

prunePaths.description: Payload paths deleted before packing, to keep the box to what it actually needs at run time. Pruning a distribution the lock requires is rejected.

selfTest.description: Run with the payload's own interpreter before the box is archived. It doubles as the check a consumer repeats after installing.

files.description: Files that must still exist after pruning, which is what stops an over-aggressive prune from shipping a broken box.

pythonCode.description: Extra Python executed after the imports succeed, for checks a bare import cannot make.

payloadPath.description: A path inside the box payload: always relative, and never escaping the payload root.
